# Business Overview
M&D Parfum is a luxury perfume boutique that promises an exclusive and refined experience. The ideal customer seeks sophistication, exclusivity in fragrance collection, with the aspiration to elevate their personal brand through high-quality scents.

| Strength | Weakness | Opportunity | Threat |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unique Luxury Positioning: Exclusivity of scent selection appeals to niche market segments.| Lackluster CTA strategy reduces potential conversion opportunities. |
